description: NaH₃(SeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.22 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.60 Å) H-O bond length. Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.83 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom.
